title: Living here
objective: Say that one person lives here in your Spanish profile.

teaching.title: Match the person and place
teaching.body: Spanish changes the form of vivir to match the person you are speaking to. Your profile also chooses the usual word for ‘here’. The example below shows both choices together.

es-AR: Use the informal vos form for one person.
With vos, vivir ends in -ís; then use the nearby-place word acá.
Start with ‘Vos vivís…’ and finish with the word for ‘here’.
es-419: Use the informal tú form for one person.
With tú, vivir becomes vives; then use the nearby-place word aquí.
Start with ‘Tú vives…’ and finish with the word for ‘here’.
es-ES: Use the informal tú form for one person.
With tú, vivir becomes vives; then use the nearby-place word aquí.
Start with ‘Tú vives…’ and finish with the word for ‘here’.

collections.title: Present -ir forms
collections.description: Review the present-tense form used when speaking to one person.
